text: {"memo": "Walmart Inc. (WMT) delivered strong performance in FY2025, with revenue reaching $674.54\u202fbillion, up from $642.64\u202fbillion in FY2024, representing roughly a 5% year\u2011over\u2011year increase. Net income rose to $19.44\u202fbillion from $15.51\u202fbillion, a 25% improvement, while operating income grew to $29.35\u202fbillion from $27.01\u202fbillion, about a 9% rise. Diluted EPS increased to $2.41 from $1.91, reflecting a 26% gain. Operating cash flow improved modestly to $36.44\u202fbillion from $35.73\u202fbillion. Margins tightened slightly: operating margin rose to roughly 4.3% from 4.2%, and net profit margin expanded to about 2.9% from 2.4%. Walmart continues to leverage its extensive retail network and e\u2011commerce platform to capture incremental sales and improve inventory turnover. The firm\u2019s disciplined expense management helped lift operating income despite modest top\u2011line growth. Strong cash flow generation provides flexibility for share repurchases and strategic acquisitions, reinforcing its defensive yet growth\u2011oriented profile. Investors appreciate the consistent earnings power and the ability to navigate inflationary pressures while maintaining market share. View: Overweight"}
